name: Lakeview Elementary School
notes: The school exists and is current — the seed's 'Current/Historical' status is just Current. Opened for the 2010-11 school year: a Wentzville Patch article (June 2011) documents the end of 'the very first school year at Lakeview' with a time-capsule burial, describing it as 'one of Wentzville School District's newest schools'. SURPRISE / seed ZIP error: the campus is at 2501 Mexico Road, Wentzville MO 63385 (school's own site + NCES-derived listings), not '63367 area' as the seed claims — it presumably appears in 63367 listings because its attendance boundary overlaps.

name: Lake St. Louis Rural Schools
notes: NOT A SINGLE SCHOOL: the seed row is a collective placeholder for the rural one-/two-room common-district schools that occupied the farmland where the Lake St. Louis planned community was later built (development began in the 1960s; the area today is served by Wentzville R-IV, ALL-616). No yearbook was ever produced under this name. No named roster of those rural schools was resolvable via web search; the seed's 'closed 1960s' is consistent with Missouri's consolidation era (1947 School District Reorganization Act; St. Charles County districts were merged into reorganized districts from 1949 on — see Fort Zumwalt district history) but no specific year can be pinned. Recommended human follow-up: St. Charles County rural district maps / county historical society to enumerate the predecessor schools of present-day 63367.

name: Boone-Duden Area Schools
notes: NOT A SINGLE SCHOOL: collective row for the one-room schools of the Boone/Duden area of western St. Charles County (Township 45, Range 2 — New Melle/Foristell area, territory later absorbed into what became Francis Howell and Wentzville reorganized districts). The 'Just a Walk Down the Road' history blog (drawing on Boone-Duden Historical Society grade books) names member schools: Bacon School #64 (started before 1875 on land of Williamson Bacon; closed June 2, 1950, building sold 1952), Calamus Springs School #65, and Hamburg School (all one-room schools in Township 45 Range 2). Citation: http://justawalkdowntheroad.blogspot.com/2015/02/normal-0-microsoftinternetexplorer4_17.html. Seed's 'opened 1800s / closed 1950s' is consistent with this (Bacon: pre-1875 to 1950) but no single open/close year applies to the set. The 63367 ZIP linkage is borderline — Township 45R2 is further west than Lake St. Louis; its inclusion is community-level only.

name: Wentzville School District
notes: ADMINISTRATIVE DISTRICT ONLY: Wentzville R-IV (NCES district ID 2931650) is a multi-school district headquartered at 280 Interstate Drive, Wentzville MO 63385 — it has no yearbook of its own. Member schools (per Wikipedia's district article and the district site): high schools Holt, Timberland, Liberty, North Point; middle schools Frontier, South, Wentzville, North Point; elementaries Boone Trail, Crossroads (ALL-612), Discovery Ridge (ALL-611), Duello, Green Tree, Heritage, Journey, Lakeview (ALL-613), Peine Ridge, Prairie View, Stone Creek, Wabash; plus Barfield Early Childhood Center. District formation date not found online (R-IV designation dates to the 1947-era Missouri reorganization, exact vote year unverified). Track B searches must target member schools, not this row.
